data.title: Man City launch appeal against explosive financial ruling
data.description: MANCHESTER - Manchester City confirmed on Friday that they had launched an appeal against a damning judgement that found the club guilty of more than 100 charges related to serious breaches of the Premier League’s financial rules.

data.title: Three more golds help Thailand surpass target
data.description: Thailand’s women made a splash on the water and a statement on the sand and in the boxing ring at the Asian Games, as a three-gold haul on Friday took the Kingdom to 15 golds in Aichi-Nagoya, one better than its target of 14.

data.title: Spain housing reform vote pending as protests mount
data.description: MADRID - Spain’s parliament was to vote Friday on government housing decrees introduced after nationwide protests triggered by the eviction of an 87-year-old woman, but there were doubts the measures would pass.

data.title: Swedish Social Democrats try again to form government
data.description: STOCKHOLM - Sweden’s parliament speaker said on Friday that he had asked Social Democrats leader Magdalena Andersson to make a new attempt to form a government, days after a first bid failed.

data.title: Flydubai pilot opened cockpit door to save passengers
data.description: DUBAI - An Indian pilot attacked by his co-pilot aboard a flight from the UAE to Israel said on Friday that he “could not let all those people die”, in his first public remarks after he helped stop the plane from crashing.

data.title: North Korean leader’s sister calls Seoul ‘despicable’
data.description: SEOUL - Kim Yo Jong, the powerful sister of North Korea’s leader, called South Korea “despicable” Friday after Seoul demanded an apology over an explosion in the Demilitarised Zone that wounded three of its soldiers.

data.title: Your weekly horoscope for Oct 2-8
data.description: Your spot-on weekly horoscope for work, money and relationships from Guru by Bangkok Post 's famously accurate fortune teller. Let's see how you will fare this week and beyond.

data.title: Guru's Weekly Buzz: Oct 2-8
data.description: Guru By Bangkok Post's weekly pick of the most exciting products, activities, food and travel to indulge in.

data.title: Indian flydubai pilot opened cockpit door to save passengers
data.description: NEW DELHI — Indian flydubai captain Smit Machchhar knew he had to act quickly after an alleged in-flight attack by his co-pilot, opening the cockpit door in a "last push" to get help and avert disaster, he said Friday.

data.title: Two suspects deny premeditated murder of Russian siblings
data.description: CHON BURI - The two men accused of robbing, raping and killing two Russian siblings in Chonburi in July have pleaded guilty to most of the charges against them but denied the claim of premeditated murder at Pattaya Provincial Court on Friday.

data.title: Baggage claims to be moved to new location, Transport Ministry promises THAI compensation
data.description: Thai Airways International (THAI) will move bag collection to a new place on Saturday as the Transport Ministry has pledged financial compensation for flyers affected by flight and baggage chaos after flooding paralysed the airline.

data.title: Macron urges G7 coordination as US presses Europe on diesel stocks
data.description: BRUSSELS (BELGIUM) - French leader Emmanuel Macron urged G7 nations to work together to bring down fuel prices in a call with President Donald Trump on Friday, as Washington pressures Europe to tap its strategic diesel reserves and threatens curbs on US exports.

data.title: Driver charged after EV hits Yaowarat shrine, killing one
data.description: A 78-year-old driver has been charged with negligence after his electric car ploughed into the Guanyin Shrine at the Thian Fah Foundation in Bangkok's Yaowarat area on Thursday, killing an 82-year-old woman, police said.

data.title: Flooding persists in 31 provinces, Bangkok, affecting 1.24m households
data.description: Flooding remains widespread across 31 provinces and Bangkok, with more than 1.24 million households affected nationwide, as authorities intensify drainage operations and provide urgent assistance to affected residents.

data.title: Thai Airways CEO ousted over flood mishaps
data.description: The board of directors of Thai Airways International Public Co Ltd on Friday dismissed Chief Executive Officer Chai Eamsiri following the widespread mismanagement of flight schedules and severe baggage backlogs during heavy flooding in the capital that started Sept 25.

data.title: World powers gather in Pacific to chart climate battle
data.description: WELLINGTON - World powers are flying delegates to the Pacific to haggle over the fight against global warming, and to see the plight of island nations surrounded by a rising ocean.

data.title: Taiwan receives its first US-made F-16V fighter jets
data.description: TAITUNG (TAIWAN) - Taiwan received on Friday its first F-16V fighter jets made by the United States, as the island democracy upgrades its military capabilities to deter a potential Chinese attack.

data.title: Hotelier returns 100,000 baht in euros to French tourist
data.description: The owner of an accommodation near Phuket airport successfully returned a bundle of euro banknotes left in a wardrobe, estimated to be worth about 100,000 baht, to a French tourist on Friday, receiving thanks and a 100-baht tip.

data.title: TPC unites 100-plus organisations at AT ONE IMPACT WEEK 2026
data.description: TPC and NO.17 Foundation brought together more than 100 organisations worldwide to announce new strategic collaborations to advance the Well-being Economy, driving change across climate restoration, land, food, ocean, finance, investment and human development. Held in Singapore for its second year, AT ONE IMPACT WEEK 2026 welcomed more than 5,000 participants from across Asia.

data.title: ONE Championship: Eersel, Jarvis make weight for lightweight Muay Thai title rematch
data.description: George Jarvis’s second shot at Regian Eersel’s ONE Championship lightweight Muay Thai world title is set for Friday night after both cleared weight and hydration for The Inner Circle 33.

data.title: Baggage claims to be moved to new location, transport ministry promises Thai Airways compensation
data.description: Thai Airways International (Thai) will move bag collection to a new place on Saturday as the Transport Ministry has pledged financial compensation for flyers affected by flight and baggage chaos after flooding paralysed the airline.

data.title: Huawei supports employees during flooding, delivers relief supplies to communities
data.description: Bangkok, September 30, 2026 – Huawei Technologies (Thailand) Co., Ltd. announced that, following heavy rainfall and flash flooding across Bangkok from Sept 25-27, 2026, several areas continue to experience high water levels, causing significant disruption to travel. A few Huawei employees have also been affected by the flooding. In response, the company established a dedicated emergency coordination team to provide urgent assistance, including arranging boats and delivering food to employees affected by the situation.

data.title: Central Pattana Wins 3 PropertyGuru Awards, Top Honours for BAAN NINYA KRABI
data.description: Central Pattana’s President & CEO is named Real Estate Personality of the Year 2026, recognising his leadership in the property sector and his vision for drawing on the company’s mixed-use development expertise to create homes, shape cities and enhance quality of life.

data.title: Lula, Bolsonaro trade scandal fire in final scramble for votes
data.description: BRASíLIA - Brazil's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and his election rival Flavio Bolsonaro are leaving no controversy unturned in their last-ditch efforts to discredit each other and win over voters ahead of Sunday's nail-biter election.
